bio: Giovanna Sacco, whose name is also written Joanna and Saccoija, was born in 1640 at San Mango di Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy. She lived her whole life there and died on 17 April 1698, when her burial was entered in the San Mango parish register. She is John's 11th-great-grandmother.
